manifest.description: Ensure a Guice Vaadin module provides Provider<UI> and Provider<VaadinSession> bindings for caller-side Vaadin static lookup rewrites.
when_to_use: Vaadin static lookup call sites have been rewritten to injected providers and the project needs the matching Guice provider bindings
a Vaadin + Guice project has no explicit Provider<UI> or Provider<VaadinSession> binding in the selected module
operator has identified the Guice module/config class that should own Vaadin request-scoped provider bindings
anti_patterns: do not use for Spring/Vaadin projects; the planner refuses Spring variants in v1
do not use when the target class is not a Guice module/config class
do not run blindly on every caller rewrite; this is a project setup helper for the binding owner

source.description: Java Guice module/config class that should own the Vaadin provider bindings.

module_name.description: Optional class name; defaults to the first class in source.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-vaadin-provider-binding-generation. Charter: ensure project-level Guice provider bindings for Vaadin UI/session access.

Protocol:

1. Ground the target module:
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")
   bbox_code_symbols(project_dir="{{project_dir}}", query="AbstractModule Provider VaadinSession UI", languages=["java"])

2. Plan the binding helper:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_vaadin_provider_binding_generation",
                      deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source}}",
                      module_name="{{module_name}}")

   The planner is Guice-only in v1. It refuses Spring/Vaadin variants, requires a Guice module/config class, adds missing imports, and adds provider methods only when matching Provider<UI> / Provider<VaadinSession> bindings are absent.

3. Review before applying:
   - confirm the selected source is the intended binding owner
   - confirm no existing framework-specific binding should be preferred
   - if the plan is empty, report that bindings are already present

4. Apply only if requested:
   bbox_refactor_apply(plan_path="<plan_path>", confirm=true)

5. Emit done note:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line: binding module, methods added/already-present, applied/planned>)

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source}} {{module_name}} {{apply}}
